title: Reranker quant strategy: calibration audit and production guardrails
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Audit and formalize the calibration + validation workflow used to produce INT8 and FP8 reranker profiles. Deliver a reproducible pipeline, a short canary rollout plan with SLO thresholds, and a documented decision matrix for per-layer vs hybrid quantization choices. This ticket collects the calibration artifacts, records trade-offs (latency/cost/accuracy), and defines acceptance criteria for shipping quant profiles to Dedicated/Hosted routes.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible calibration pipeline in CI that converts a FP32 reranker to INT8 and FP8 using the agreed knobs
Quant profiles stored in model-catalog with metadata and checksum
Evaluation report with NDCG@10 and MRR comparing FP32, INT8, and FP8 on the canonical rerank testset
Canary rollout plan with alert thresholds (NDCG drop <= 1.0% relative to FP32; latency improvement recorded)
Hand-off doc for SRE/Console to monitor per-route quality regressions
calibration_workflow: Assemble calibration corpus: 50k query-doc pairs sampled from production logs (1:3 positive:negative ratio) with stratification by query frequency
Compute activation ranges via batchwise KL divergence and per-channel min/max collection (50k samples)
Run per-channel symmetric weight quantization for INT8; test hybrid option where large matrix multiplications use 8-bit and attention projections use fp16 fallback
For FP8 experiments use block floating emulation with exponent scaling + bias correction; collect outlier statistics and clamp thresholds
Apply bias correction and per-tensor activation scale refinement using MSE minimization on a held-out calibration split
Produce final quant profile JSON (weights scale, clip thresholds, per-layer mode) and store in S3 under s3://redwood-quant-profiles/reranker/<sha>/
Record deterministic seed and toolchain versions (torch 2.2, custom kernel v1.5, quant-tool v0.9) in the artifact manifest
eval_summary: Evaluation harness: rerank-eval v2 (GitHub: github.com/redwood/rerank-eval) using canonical testset (25k queries, doc pool up to 100)
INT8 (per-channel weights, per-tensor activations, bias-correction): NDCG@10 = 0.4091 (-0.70% rel); MRR = 0.2731 (-1.05% rel)
FP8 (experimental block-float, calibrated scales): NDCG@10 = 0.4101 (-0.23% rel); MRR = 0.2750 (-0.36% rel)
Latency (p50 token infer on reranker endpoint): FP32=28ms, INT8=20ms (-28%), FP8=18ms (-36%) on p4d instance with current kernel builds
Cost proxy (inference token units): INT8 ~0.65x FP32; FP8 ~0.58x FP32
Notes: INT8 shows consistent small regressions concentrated on tail queries with rare tokens; FP8 reduced regressions but requires kernel maturity and careful overflow handling
